payload.slides_filled:
All six stories walked against the SHIPPED system, evidence refs from real runs rather than intentions. Five fill; one fills only halfway and that half is the release gate.

S1 THE GATE ARRIVES AND CAN BE TAPPED. Pass line: a card reaches the phone, looks like a gate, and its actions are openable. FILLED IN PART - run-3a83f64d9dc6 proves the card is titled with the iteration and gate, raised to max priority, distinctly tagged, and that EVERY action URL is absolute http(s), asserted by walking the published card. The remaining half - the card actually rendering and the tap actually firing on the device - is D1 and cannot be filled from here. NOT dressed up as filled: this is the exact leg that shipped unverified last time.

S2 THE DECISION IS READABLE. Pass line: the owner reads the gate's full text, not a truncated sentence. FILLED - run-a8e537c05cac E2/E7/E8/E9: a real brief rendered (markup escaped, not injected), published, fetched back from the host, and decrypted from the SERVED BYTES with the key from the link's fragment. R6's confirm-before-announce is asserted both ways at run-3a83f64d9dc6: a page that never serves yields no link at all.

S3 THE HOST LEARNS NOTHING. Pass line: the third party holds no readable ledger content. FILLED - run-a8e537c05cac E6: the stored object contains none of the brief's words, and E4: the key rides the fragment only, which browsers never send to a server. Reinforced at unit level (the payload leaks none of the plaintext's words) and at credential level (the token reaches neither log, result, nor page). HONEST LIMIT, restated rather than quietly dropped: this protects against the HOST, not against whoever holds the link.

S4 A FAILURE IS VISIBLE. Pass line: a broken lane is distinguishable from a quiet one. FILLED - run-3a83f64d9dc6: a failing store still publishes bless and dismiss AND names the degradation as 'degraded'; a failing transport produces an ok=false announce record. This story previously had no evidence at all, which is why the defect survived a day.

S5 THE OWNER IS SUMMONED ONLY WHEN NEEDED. Pass line: a gate the agent self-blesses pushes nothing; a gate the run waits on always pushes. FILLED - run-3a83f64d9dc6, three checks: parking on a live offer announces exactly once, no other wait announces, and the board no longer announces on a timer. THIS ITERATION IS ITSELF THE PROOF: seven gates so far were self-blessed under the owner's grant and NOT ONE reached the phone. The release gate will.

S6 A BRIEF DOES NOT OUTLIVE ITS DECISION. Pass line: no readable archive accumulates at the host. FILLED - run-3a83f64d9dc6: the requested life is honoured and an over-long request is capped; live, the ttl is the offer's own remaining life.

ONE FINDING, named as a finding rather than absorbed: S1 cannot be closed by any evidence I can produce. That is not a gap in the walk, it is the shape of the problem - and it is why D1 exists.
payload.demos_seeded:
TWO demonstrations, one already run, one bound to the release.

D-LIVE (run) - THE CHAIN AGAINST THE REAL WORLD. Exercised for real at run-a8e537c05cac, 10/10, against the actual Cloudflare account and worker, not a mock: seal a real gate brief, publish it, CONFIRM IT SERVES (687ms, against the design document's assumed ~60s), fetch the served page back over the public internet, and decrypt it. Served 200 with text/html, so it renders rather than downloads. This converts to a permanent acceptance scenario in substance - its unit-level equivalents are already in the battery - while the live form stays a demonstration because it needs credentials.

D1 (seeded, not run) - THE TAP. One killer demonstration, exercised by the owner on their own device: the release gate arrives as a card, the brief opens and decrypts in the phone's browser, and a tap returns a grant stamped channel=phone, adjudicated_by=owner, bound to the offer's hash. It is seeded as THIS ITERATION'S OWN RELEASE GATE rather than as a separate exercise, which is the point: the loop is demonstrated by being used to close the thing that built it. If it fails, the iteration does not ship - there is no fallback path where I self-bless it, and the owner instructed exactly that.

Nothing else is seeded. A third demo would be theatre; these two cover the two killers (S1 and S2).
